title: Variables check
instructions: Four questions on names, values and types.

questions.prompt: After x = 5, then x = x + 1, what does print(x) show?
questions.explanation: Python works out the right side (5 + 1) first, then attaches x to the result.
A number with a decimal part is a float, even when the decimal part is zero.

questions.prompt: What happens when Python runs print("5" + 3)?
questions.explanation: "5" is text and 3 is a number. Python will not guess which kind of addition you meant.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a valid Python variable name?
questions.explanation: Names use letters, digits and underscores, and cannot start with a digit or contain spaces or hyphens.
